summary.zh: 讲清陌生仓库的架构与阅读顺序，产出上手文档
summary.en: Explain an unfamiliar repo's architecture and write onboarding docs.

description.zh: 通读仓库后给出架构概览、模块职责、关键流程和推荐的阅读顺序，并整理成给新人看的上手文档。适合刚加入项目、接手他人代码或需要快速了解整体结构时使用。
description.en: Reads a repository and explains its architecture, module responsibilities and key flows, plus a suggested reading order, as onboarding docs. Use it when joining a project, inheriting code or needing a quick grasp of the whole.
